remarks: Welcome to 46 Ponus Avenue, a charming home in the heart of Norwalk offering great potential and flexibility. This property features bright living spaces, a functional layout, and comfortable bedrooms suited for everyday living. While the home may benefit from some updates, it is ready for occupancy and presents an excellent opportunity to make it your own or invest.  The lower level includes an extra room, perfect for a home office, guest space, or additional living area. Outside, enjoy a nice-sized backyard ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and major highways, this property offers both value and location.  A great opportunity for homeowners or investors alike-don't miss it! Property is being sold As-Is.
